purpose: One bounded Stage-1 pilot after train-only amplitude, severity, and within-view spatial-support diagnostics passed.

target_scaling.population: train-only valid cells with measured paired target > 1e-6; corruption mask is not read

optimization.checkpoint_selection: minimum route-disjoint validation total loss only

gate.native_development: reuse the fully preregistered Epic fog gate without changing thresholds

data_roles.optimizer: 35 train routes; local_blur and local_dark only
data_roles.checkpoint_selection: 5 disjoint routes; local_blur and local_dark only
data_roles.heldout_family: local_glare on validation and held-out routes; never used for checkpoint selection
data_roles.native_development: exact-pose Epic fog; never used for checkpoint selection

continuation.if_all_gates_pass: freeze checkpoint and run new untouched native rain/low-sun plus finite-window sensor confirmation
continuation.if_epic_fog_fails: stop and add physically grounded supervision
